x-provenance.recorded-by: Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass kalshi-markets of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The raised-by and asks fields are the Leader's own words from the cited utterances; the requirements are the EARS rendering of what those words ask and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Kalshi recorder stores what the venue will not return later, in few and small data files, and stores nothing the venue can be asked again.

requirements.says: The Kalshi recorder shall retain data that cannot be re-queried from the venue, because the more of it the Group holds the more valuable it becomes.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "KEEP THE DATA THAT IS EPHEMERAL THAT IF WE DO NOT STORE IT THEN WE CANNOT READ IT LATER"; "building that sort of data is part of our routine operations".

requirements.says: The Kalshi recorder shall not retain data the venue returns on request.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "I DID NOT say keep 1gb of KALSHI data every day".

requirements.says: The Kalshi recorder shall write no more bytes than convey the same information, in fewer and smaller data files.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "don't write many bytes when few bytes convey literally the same info".

requirements.says: The Kalshi recorder shall not store its data as per-day SQLite files.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "1gb of kalshi data a day!?!? sqlite files?!?!?".

requirements.says: The Kalshi recorder shall migrate existing data in a one-time migration to the smaller form.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "If this requires one-time migrations of data, that's fine too".

board-opening.context: Cold Red Gate disk facts are in 2026-10-09-note-on-cold-red-gates-disk.md (operations). This record carries the Leader's rule for what is kept.
